name: editorial duel
principles: give each subject a distinct color and motion identity
use real appetizing media as the stage, not decoration
large condensed typography behaves like a poster
compositionRules: open with a full-bleed visual collision
alternate left and right subject ownership
use ingredient objects that emerge from labels
reserve equal columns for the one decisive comparison scene
motionRules: subject a uses vertical lift, stacking, and bounce
subject b uses lateral sweep, spin, and fold
process scenes animate the actual physical action
the ending resolves both motion languages together
mediaRules: search for close-up process photography and recognizable finished results
prefer warm directional light and visible texture
use generated svg only for explanatory overlays, not as a substitute for hero photography
